\section{Introduction}
This is an test of the speling checker, as shown in \cite{knuth84} and Section~\ref{sec:x}.
We use an $n$-gram model where $\alpha = 1$ and the loss is
\begin{equation}
  L = \sum_i \log p(x_i) \label{eq:loss}
\end{equation}
which is minimised. The \emph{results} in Table~\ref{tab:a} shows that it work well.
